主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced on August 30, 2019, that it requested the delisting of all Class A Limited Voting Shares from Euronext Amsterdam due to low trading volume, costs, and administrative requirements. The company confirmed its shares will remain listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Toronto Stock Exchange. Approval was received for the delisting, effective September 30, 2019, with the last trading date set for September 27, 2019. Shareholders holding Brookfield Euronext Shares can sell their shares on the NYSE and/or TSX. Shareholders may request additional information from their custodian and financial intermediary. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Brookfield Asset Management Inc. (BAM).
